sloka: गोष्ठे महति मुख्यानाम् गवाम् मध्ये यथा वृषः ।स राक्षस इन्द्रः शुशुभे ताभिः परिवृतः स्वयम् ॥५-११-९॥
transliteration: goṣṭhe mahati mukhyānām gavām madhye yathā vṛṣaḥ ।sa rākṣasa indraḥ śuśubhe tābhiḥ parivṛtaḥ svayam ॥5-11-9॥

translations.english: Surrounded by the women, the demon king shone like a proud elephant attended by many female elephants scattered in a dense forest.
